solutions.title: Two pointers overwrite
solutions.description:
**Approach:** Copy every non-`val` into the next write slot; return write count.

**Complexity:** Time **O(n)**, space **O(1)**.

**Why preferred:** Order of kept elements can change unless you keep relative order; still meets the problem contract without shifting.

solutions.title: In-place splice removals
solutions.description:
**Approach:** Scan; `splice` out each `val` without advancing `i` after a removal.

**Complexity:** Time **O(n²)** typical, space **O(1)**.

**vs recommended:** Same in-place idea. Prefer overwrite/two-pointer so removals are **O(1)** each.
